letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the soft monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laughter is the soundtrack of my days, and your smile lights up every corner of my heart, no matter the time zone. I’m forever grateful for the way you turn ordinary moments into unforgettable adventures, cutie. Here’s to another year of love that dances across continents, growing richer with each shared sunset.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the lake,  
Your love’s the gift I gladly take.  
In every wind, in every rain,  
With you, my heart knows no refrain.
